selection: All38 N76 and all40 N78 reviewer receipts,including original failures;zero-mutation source episodes retained in coverage. No category/task/outcome selection.
criteria: Target YES with unsupported step or goal YES with time-conflict step: internal conflict
Target NO without unsupported step or goal NO without temporal conflict: unsupported dimension evidence,not proof of false denial
Conflict quote exactly matches encoded time under explicit initial-clock/same-date arithmetic assumptions: binding-review flag,not proof of semantic agreement
Previous-action/event timing requires unresolved binding;no stale-countdown extrapolation,precision tolerance or guessed phase
metrics: Flag counts by source,class and record
Distinct contexts/tasks and repeated source coverage
Reused review tokens separate from zero new requests/GPU;CPU hash/parse/audit/write timing
exclusions: None. Invalid outputs remain in every original denominator;flags do not correct original labels or admit blocking.
stop_rule: One78-record read-only audit. No model requests,online expansion,selective retry,prompt/schema/gate tuning or new truth labels.
scope: Previously exposed official single-turn public traces only;not independent entailment/false-rejection accuracy,SR,Task completion,new benchmark,training or default adoption.
